decision.reason: Substantial grain reduction but lost fabric cords, blurred facade/truss/leaves, low-frequency sky variation and severely weakened fence contrast in the12 actually viewed serial triplets. Small optional reference only; no bulk/GPU/fullframe benchmark or architecture change selected.

result.changes: Guard three x86 intrinsic includes and two unused archived static inline helpers (definitions have zero call sites). Canonical processing code is unchanged. FP contraction off, no fast-math. Cross-architecture numerical identity is unproven; this is an explicit local CPU port, not the original x86 executable.

pilot.input_contract: Original packed signed observations unpacked exactly; clamp to [0,1] for the publisher's documented input range, with every clipped count recorded. No WB/gain transform before the raw denoiser. Output Bayer is independently WB-aware Malvar demosaiced. No fitting to reference.

result.scope: Independent layout/clipping/command contract and Torch64 metric arithmetic; saved Bayer-to-RGB and PNG rerenders use the declared production Malvar/render as an artifact check. No independent recreation of GALOSH, original x86/GPU parity, actual visual inspection, full-frame speed or quality promotion.
Same binary/settings/input repeated once on this AArch64 host. Serial reproducibility at one observation, not general determinism or x86/GPU parity.

result.interpretation: Exact-repeat assertion failed; not accepted under a widened tolerance. Source contains dynamically scheduled parallel block accumulation/reductions; this observation alone does not isolate its cause or establish original-x86 parity. Retain first outputs; rerun separately with serial OpenMP for a reproducible reference probe. Neural model/training code unchanged.

native_visual_review.notes: Both photographic modes remove much of the noise while losing fine cords/cloud/facade definition. Sky has low-frequency mottling; building truss stays soft, foliage edges blur and fence-wire contrast is severely reduced. Supplied-nominal and blind appearances remain similar. Real ISO100 references differ in aperture/time/motion and are not GT.

Supplied noise is nominal; the publisher's stabilized-sigma reestimate remains active. Real reference is not GT and has no scores. scope: Local AArch64 port of a genuine pinned training-free CPU reference with two unused SSE helpers/header includes guarded. No original x86/GPU parity. Two fixed CPU-noise photos and four cached512px GFX contexts; no model training or target fitting. Serial artifact/metric checks and actual native viewing complete; SOTA and requested neural quality remain unproven. V67 frozen experiment remains unchanged.
